chunks.section: The minimal AI software engineering agent
chunks.content_en:
## The minimal AI software engineering agent

In 2024, we built [SWE-bench](https://github.com/swe-bench/SWE-bench) & [SWE-agent](https://github.com/swe-agent/swe-agent) and helped kickstart the coding agent revolution.

We now ask: **What if our agent was 100x simpler, and still worked nearly as well?**

`mini` is

- **Widely adopted**: Used by Meta, NVIDIA, Essential AI, IBM, Nebius, Anyscale, Princeton University, Stanford University, and many more.
chunks.content_zh:
## 极简 AI 软件工程智能体

2024 年，我们构建了 [SWE-bench](https://github.com/swe-bench/SWE-bench) 和 [SWE-agent](https://github.com/swe-agent/swe-agent)，并帮助开启了编码智能体革命。

我们现在问：**如果我们的智能体简单 100 倍，而且仍然几乎一样好用，会怎样？**

`mini` 是

- **被广泛采用**：被 Meta、NVIDIA、Essential AI、IBM、Nebius、Anyscale、普林斯顿大学、斯坦福大学等众多机构使用。

chunks.section: The minimal AI software engineering agent
chunks.content_en:
## The minimal AI software engineering agent

- **Minimal**: Just some 100 lines of python for the [agent class](https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent/blob/main/src/minisweagent/agents/default.py) (and a bit more for the [environment](https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent/blob/main/src/minisweagent/environments/local.py),
[model](https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent/blob/main/src/minisweagent/models/litellm_model.py), and [run script](https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent/blob/main/src/minisweagent/run/hello_world.py)) — no fancy dependencies!
chunks.content_zh:
## 极简 AI 软件工程智能体（Agent）

- **极简**：仅用约 100 行 Python 实现 [Agent 类](https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent/blob/main/src/minisweagent/agents/default.py)（[环境](https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent/blob/main/src/minisweagent/environments/local.py)、[模型](https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent/blob/main/src/minisweagent/models/litellm_model.py)和[运行脚本](https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent/blob/main/src/minisweagent/run/hello_world.py)稍多一些）——没有花哨的依赖！

chunks.section: The minimal AI software engineering agent
chunks.content_en:
## The minimal AI software engineering agent

- **Performant:** Scores >74% on the [SWE-bench verified benchmark](https://www.swebench.com/); starts much faster than Claude Code
- **Deployable:** Supports **local environments**, **docker/podman**, **singularity/apptainer**, **bublewrap**, **contree**, and more
- **Compatible:** Supports all models via **litellm**, **openrouter**, **portkey**, and more. Support for `/completion` and `/response` endpoints, interleaved thinking etc.
chunks.content_zh:
## 极简 AI 软件工程智能体（agent）

- **高性能：** 在 [SWE-bench verified 基准](https://www.swebench.com/) 上得分 >74%；启动速度比 Claude Code 快得多
- **可部署：** 支持**本地环境**、**docker/podman**、**singularity/apptainer**、**bublewrap**、**contree** 等
- **兼容性：** 通过 **litellm**、**openrouter**、**portkey** 等支持所有模型。支持 `/completion` 和 `/response` 端点、交错思考（interleaved thinking）等

chunks.section: The minimal AI software engineering agent
chunks.content_en:
## The minimal AI software engineering agent

- Built by the Princeton & Stanford team behind [SWE-bench](https://swebench.com), [SWE-agent](https://swe-agent.com), and more
chunks.content_zh:
## 极简 AI 软件工程智能体

- 由 [SWE-bench](https://swebench.com)、[SWE-agent](https://swe-agent.com) 等背后的普林斯顿与斯坦福团队打造

chunks.content_en:
## More motivation (for research)

[SWE-agent](https://swe-agent.com/latest/) jump-started the development of AI agents in 2024. Back then, we placed a lot of emphasis on tools and special interfaces for the agent.
However, one year later, as LMs have become more capable, a lot of this is not needed at all to build a useful agent!
In fact, the `mini` agent
chunks.content_zh:
## 更多动机（面向研究）

[SWE-agent](https://swe-agent.com/latest/) 在 2024 年推动了 AI 智能体的发展。当时，我们非常重视为智能体提供的工具和特殊接口。
然而，一年之后，随着语言模型（LM）变得更强大，其中很多内容对于构建有用的智能体来说已经完全不需要了！
事实上，`mini` 智能体

chunks.content_en:
## More motivation (for research)

- **Does not have any tools other than bash** — it doesn't even need to use the tool-calling interface of the LMs. This means that you can run it with literally any model. When running in sandboxed environments you also don't need to take care
  of installing a single package — all it needs is bash. - **Has a completely linear history** — every step of the agent just appends to the messages and that's it. So there's no difference between the trajectory and the messages that you pass on to the LM.
chunks.content_zh:
## 更多动机（研究方面）

- **除了 bash 之外没有任何工具**——它甚至不需要使用语言模型（LMs）的工具调用接口。这意味着你真的可以用任何模型运行它。在沙盒环境中运行时，你也不需要操心安装任何一个包——它只需要 bash。
- **拥有完全线性的历史记录**——智能体（agent）的每一步只是把内容追加到 messages 中，仅此而已。所以轨迹（trajectory）与你传给语言模型（LM）的 messages 之间没有区别。

chunks.content_en:
## More motivation (for research)

Great for debugging & fine-tuning. - **Executes actions with `subprocess.run`** — every action is completely independent (as opposed to keeping a stateful shell session running). This makes it trivial to execute the actions in sandboxes (literally just switch out `subprocess.run` with `docker exec`) and to
  scale up effortlessly. Seriously, this is [a big deal](https://mini-swe-agent.com/latest/faq/#why-no-shell-session), trust me.
chunks.content_zh:
## 更多动机（用于研究）

非常适合调试和微调。- **使用 `subprocess.run` 执行动作**——每个动作都完全独立（而不是保持一个有状态的 shell 会话运行）。这使得在沙箱中执行动作变得轻而易举（实际上只需将 `subprocess.run` 替换为 `docker exec`），并且可以轻松扩展。说真的，这是[一件大事](https://mini-swe-agent.com/latest/faq/#why-no-shell-session)，相信我。

chunks.content_en:
## More motivation (for research)

This makes it perfect as a baseline system and for a system that puts the language model (rather than
the agent scaffold) in the middle of our attention.
You can see the result on the [SWE-bench (bash only)](https://www.swebench.com/) leaderboard, that evaluates the performance of different LMs with `mini`.
chunks.content_zh:
## 更多研究动机

这使其非常适合作为基线系统，也适合作为一个将语言模型（而非智能体脚手架）置于我们关注中心的系统。
你可以在 [SWE-bench（仅 bash）](https://www.swebench.com/) 排行榜上看到结果，该排行榜用 `mini` 评估不同语言模型的表现。

chunks.content_en:
## More motivation (as a tool)

Some agents are overfitted research artifacts. Others are UI-heavy frontend monsters.

The `mini` agent wants to be a hackable tool, not a black box.

- **Simple** enough to understand at a glance
- **Convenient** enough to use in daily workflows
- **Flexible** to extend

Unlike other agents (including our own [swe-agent](https://swe-agent.com/latest/)), it is radically simpler, because it:
chunks.content_zh:
## 更多动机（作为工具）

有些 agent 是过度拟合的研究产物。另一些则是 UI 密集的前端怪物。

`mini` agent 想成为一个可改造的工具，而不是黑盒。

- **简单**到一眼就能理解
- **方便**到可用于日常工作流
- **灵活**到可以扩展

与其他 agent（包括我们自己的 [swe-agent](https://swe-agent.com/latest/)）不同，它从根本上更简单，因为它：

chunks.content_en:
## More motivation (as a tool)

- **Does not have any tools other than bash** — it doesn't even need to use the tool-calling interface of the LMs. Instead of implementing custom tools for every specific thing the agent might want to do, the focus is fully on the LM utilizing the shell to its full potential. Want it to do something specific like opening a PR? Just tell the LM to figure it out rather than spending time to implement it in the agent.
chunks.content_zh:
## 更多动机（作为工具）

- **除了 bash 之外没有任何工具**——它甚至不需要使用语言模型（LMs）的工具调用接口。与其为智能体（Agent）可能想做的每一件具体事情实现自定义工具，不如将重点完全放在 LM 充分发挥 shell 的潜力上。想让它做某件具体的事情，比如开一个 PR？只需告诉 LM 去想办法解决，而不是花时间在智能体（Agent）中实现它。

chunks.content_en:
## More motivation (as a tool)

- **Executes actions with `subprocess.run`** — every action is completely independent (as opposed to keeping a stateful shell session running). This is [a big deal](https://mini-swe-agent.com/latest/faq/#why-no-shell-session) for the stability of the agent, trust me. - **Has a completely linear history** — every step of the agent just appends to the messages that are passed to the LM in the next step and that's it. This is great for debugging and understanding what the LM is prompted with.
chunks.content_zh:
## 更多动机（作为工具）

- **使用 `subprocess.run` 执行动作**——每个动作都完全独立（而不是保持一个有状态的 shell 会话持续运行）。这对智能体（agent）的稳定性来说[非常重要](https://mini-swe-agent.com/latest/faq/#why-no-shell-session)，相信我。
- **拥有完全线性的历史记录**——智能体（agent）的每一步只是将消息追加到下一步要传给 LM 的消息中，仅此而已。这对于调试以及理解 LM 收到的提示内容非常有帮助。

chunks.section: Should I use SWE-agent or mini-SWE-agent?
chunks.content_en:
## Should I use SWE-agent or mini-SWE-agent?

You should consider `mini-swe-agent` your default choice.
In particular, you should use `mini-swe-agent` if

- You want a quick command line tool that works locally
- You want an agent with a very simple control flow
- You want even faster, simpler & more stable sandboxing & benchmark evaluations
- You are doing FT or RL and don't want to overfit to a specific agent scaffold

You should use `swe-agent` if
chunks.content_zh:
我应该使用 SWE-agent 还是 mini-SWE-agent？

你应该把 `mini-swe-agent` 视为默认选择。
特别是，在以下情况下你应该使用 `mini-swe-agent`：

- 你想要一个可在本地运行的快速命令行工具
- 你想要一个控制流非常简单的智能体（agent）
- 你想要更快、更简单且更稳定的沙盒（sandboxing）与基准评测
- 你正在进行 FT 或 RL，并且不想过拟合到特定的智能体脚手架（agent scaffold）

chunks.section: Should I use SWE-agent or mini-SWE-agent?
chunks.content_en:
## Should I use SWE-agent or mini-SWE-agent?

- You want to experiment with different sets of tools, each with their own interface
- You want to experiment with different history processors

What you get with both

- Excellent performance on SWE-Bench
- A trajectory browser
chunks.content_zh:
## 我应该使用 SWE-agent 还是 mini-SWE-agent？

- 你想尝试不同的工具集，每个工具都有自己的接口
- 你想尝试不同的历史处理器

两者都能获得

- 在 SWE-Bench 上的出色表现
- 一个轨迹浏览器
